# TriCraft Home & Commercial

> TriCraft Home and Commercial Services LLC is a licensed home improvement contractor in Ephrata, PA, serving Lancaster County since 2016. One crew handles carpentry, plumbing and electrical work for homeowners, landlords, property managers and light commercial properties.

- Phone: (717) 799-9304
- Email: tricraft.handyman@gmail.com
- Location: Ephrata, PA 17522
- Hours: Mon-Fri 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, plus 24/7 emergency plumbing
- License: PA Home Improvement Contractor, PA 209786

## Services

- Plumbing: fixture replacements, water heater installs, faucet and toilet repairs, pipe work and drain clearing
- Electrical: wiring upgrades, lighting, outlets and switches, ceiling fans and panel upgrades
- Carpentry: trim and molding, framing, shelving, custom woodwork and deck repairs
- Doors and windows: installation, replacement, weatherstripping and hardware
- Drywall and painting: repair, patching, skim coating and touch-up painting
- Property maintenance: seasonal checks, small repairs and preventive upkeep for landlords, property managers and homeowners
- Light commercial: maintenance and repair for offices, retail spaces and rental properties
- Full improvement projects: kitchen and bath updates, basement finishing and multi-trade renovations

## Service area

Lancaster County, PA, including Ephrata, Lititz, Akron, Denver, New Holland, Terre Hill, Manheim, Mount Joy, Columbia, Lancaster, Leola, Strasburg, Quarryville, Elizabethtown and nearby towns.
